fields.summary: clarify how duplicate mappings are handled
fields.customfield_10618:
We will add a 'warning' invariant on ElementDefinition that says that mapping.identifier.distinct().count() = mapping.count()

count(distinct-values(f:mapping/f:identifier/@value))=count(f:mapping)

"There should only be one mapping per element with a given identifier"

 

We will update the profiling page to indicate that when a profiled element contains a mapping with the same id as one or more mappings in the corresponding parent element, the mapping element in the profile *replaces* the mapping element(s) in the parent with the same identifier.
